name: Stanford University
summary: Stanford is a private research university in California, founded in 1885 and opened in 1891. First-year applicants apply to the university rather than to a major. Stanford is need-blind for US citizens and permanent residents but treats a request for financial aid as a factor in admission for international applicants.

testing.typicalRange: Class of 2029 enrolled students who submitted SAT: middle 50% composite 1520-1570
testing.notes: Stanford requires either the SAT or ACT for first-year applicants; no preferred test, no minimum score. Scores are self-reported at application; official scores required on enrolment for all self-reported sittings. Latest SAT sitting: end of October (REA) or end of December (RD). Range from Stanford admission statistics (Class of 2029).

testing.typicalRange: Class of 2029 enrolled students who submitted ACT: middle 50% composite 34-36
testing.notes: Latest ACT sitting: end of September (REA) or end of December (RD).

english.waiver: Stanford does not require any English proficiency exam; applicants may self-report TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or other scores (fluency in English is a prerequisite for admission).

scholarships.name: Stanford need-based financial aid (international students)
scholarships.eligibility: International applicants must indicate on the admission application that they will apply for aid; the request is a factor in admission and aid funds for international students are limited. Applicants should submit the CSS Profile (or ISAFA if the CSS Profile is unavailable). International students who do not request aid when applying are not eligible to apply for aid later.
scholarships.coverage: Awarded from institutional funds based on family financial circumstances; amount varies

opportunities.name: Undergraduate Research (VPUE)
opportunities.description: The Vice Provost for Undergraduate Education dedicates nearly $7.5 million a year to support about 1,200 students in research projects; roughly one third of students use VPUE research funding at some point.

opportunities.name: Bing Overseas Studies Program
opportunities.description: Lets Stanford undergraduates study abroad while remaining enrolled at Stanford; about 900 students (around 50% of a class year) study away on Stanford programs each year.

programs.name: Computer Science (BS)
programs.summary: Per the Stanford Bulletin, the CS major requires a minimum of 96 units: 26 units of mathematics, 11 of science, 10 of engineering fundamentals, one Technology in Society course and 43 units of CS core, depth and senior project. Core includes CS 103, CS 106 (A/B), CS 109.

programs.name: Economics (BA)
programs.school: School of Humanities and Sciences (Department of Economics)
programs.summary: Economics BA requires 80 units (at least 55 taken at Stanford in California). The core includes ECON 1, ECON 50 (or 50Q), ECON 51 and ECON 102A (basic statistics); a grade of C or better is required in core courses beginning Fall 2024.
